rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=False, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.0003, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-12 ONE-KNOB: warm_start True->False (REMOVE the amortized warm-start pre-pass; each per-scan Adam fit now starts from RANDOM U-Net init with NO generic anchor). Base = the iter-7 WINNING baseline (lr=3e-4, n_iter=400, unet_c=16, seed=42, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1500); val_n RESET 6->4 (iter-11's val_n=6 was a ceiling-DOCUMENTATION probe, not a keep -- same reset pattern iter-11 used for grad_clip) so this isolates warm_start alone vs the 0.9562 winner. pretrain_epochs left at 8 but is INERT when warm_start=False (no pre-pass runs). FAILURE MODE (per-image U-Net N2I is structurally FBP-bounded on Mayo's 2304-view substrate, hr~0): iters 1-11 exhausted every standard lever -- (a) n_iter 400->800 marginal 0.9501->0.9508 (budget SATURATED, iters 1-2); (b) unet_c 16->32 DEAD on BOTH operating points (iter-3 lr1e-3 0.9508->0.9502; iter-8 anchored 0.9543 < winner); (c) per-scan lr LOCALIZED, 3e-4 bracketed sweet spot (iter-4 0.9541 beats 1e-3@iter-1 0.9501 and 1e-4@iter-5 0.9479 which over-anchors); (d) warm-start pretrain_epochs DIMINISHING (3->6 +0.0017 iter-6, 6->8 +0.0004 iter-7); (e) SEED probe iter-9 (42->1337) 0.9549, (f) GRAD_CLIP probe iter-10 (1.0->0.5) 0.9556, (g) VAL_N probe iter-11 (4->6) 0.9529 -- all within the ~0.953-0.956 per-image U-Net noise floor, ceiling CONFIRMED. warm_start (on since iter-1, NEVER probed) is the LAST untried per-image axis and the load-bearing assumption behind the entire regularization story (iters 4-7). HYPOTHESIS (warm-start-IS-the-anchor): the regularization narrative -- lr=3e-4 anchors each per-scan Adam fit near the warm-start init -- assumes the warm-start init IS a useful generic anchor. Setting warm_start=False REMOVES that anchor: each scan fits from random init with only its OWN GT-free angular-subset measurements (no shared prior). If val DROPS materially below ~0.95 (toward the no-anchor per-scan-overfit regime seen on demo), it CONFIRMS the warm-start anchor is load-bearing and quantifies exactly how much of the ~0.956 ceiling it contributes -- closing the regularization story. If val HOLDS near ~0.956, the per-scan fit converges to the same FBP-bounded place regardless of init, and the warm-start was inert decoration. Either outcome is a clean, decisive read on the campaign's central regularization claim, toward iter-20. EXACTLY ONE knob changes (warm_start True->False); lr/n_iter/unet_c/seed/grad_clip/val_n ALL at the iter-7 winner baseline. WALL <=15 min: removing the warm-start pre-pass (iter-11's ~290s of 8 epochs x 200 train) SHRINKS the wall vs iter-7 -- only the val loop runs (4 scenes x 400 per-scan steps, ~600s); outer_wall_s=1500 caps it. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). DO NOT revert to amortized train-then-forward; this is the per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394) -- warm_start=False is still PER-IMAGE (per-scan Adam fit on each scan's own measurements), just without the amortized init.
